instruction: In Thunderbird, access the Bills folder, select the newest email, launch the first link from it in Chrome, then close every other tab in Chrome.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the latest email in Thunderbird's Bills folder, opening the first URL (https://www.amazon.com/) in Chrome, and closing all other tabs. The evaluator verifies that only one tab is open and it's the Amazon URL. Partial credit: 0.5 for opening the Amazon tab, 0.5 for having only one tab open. Verified from email that the first URL is https://www.amazon.com/.

scoring_breakdown.1.0: Only Amazon.com tab is open (all other tabs closed)

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: (1) Amazon.com tab is open, (2) all other tabs are closed
Getter 'get_open_tabs_info' appropriately retrieves Chrome tab state needed for verification
Metric logic is sound: extracts URLs from tabs, checks expected URL presence (0.5 pts), checks only one tab exists (0.5 pts)
Partial credit scoring makes semantic sense: 0.5 for correct URL, 0.5 for closing other tabs
Expected value 'https://www.amazon.com/' is correct according to metadata explanation
URL normalization in metric (removes trailing slashes) ensures robust comparison
Metric handles edge cases (non-list result, missing 'url' field in tabs)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding postconfig to ensure Chrome is focused/visible after Thunderbird operations, though current remote connection approach should work fine
